The worker's automatic checks all passed; the dependency check reports 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with no messages and declares nothing. All 59 Checks were recomputed, 113 library names resolved at the pins and every supplier section resolved on main. Findings: missing locators (R01), the wall-crossing headline in the Suggested.lean docstring missing its degree and parity range (R02), and a reversed double cover in a Check of section 4.3 (R03).
